name: Email program and preference migration from another platform
scope: Inventory your client's active email programs, subscription types and suppression records, and agree which choice wins when sources or the CRM conflict. Import the people and their choices into Marketo Engage, set Unsubscribed, Marketing Suspended or Blocklisted with Change Data Value flow steps, so an unsubscribe covers every record with the same email address, and mark addresses that hard bounced on the old platform as Email Invalid. Set up the subscription center, rebuild the active programs with no marketing email set as operational, and check the first migrated send's blocked people and that no suppressed address is among its recipients.
evidence: Blocked people in the Marketo Engage database are marked blocklisted, unsubscribed, marketing suspended, or have an invalid or empty email.
source_title: View Blocked People in a Smart Campaign

other_pages.title: Understanding Unsubscribe
other_pages.quote: All of these fields are built-in to your Marketo subscription. They are all boolean (checkbox) type. They can be used in Forms or Change Data Value flow steps.

other_pages.title: Durable Unsubscribe
other_pages.quote: If the unsubscribe flag is set from false to true, the master email status is updated, and the change is propagated to other people with the same email address.

other_pages.title: Marketo Engage Glossary
other_pages.quote: A Marketo-hosted landing page that allows email recipients to manage their subscription preferences, choosing which types of communications they want to receive or opting out of specific categories rather than fully unsubscribing.

other_pages.title: Marketo Engage Glossary
other_pages.quote: An email that ignores Unsubscribed and Marketing Suspended status. Meant to be used for critical or auto-response emails. Not meant for marketing. Operational emails will not to be sent to people with Blocklisted or Email Invalid status.

hours_reasoning: Compared with MK02 CRM sync and field mapping (32/60/120), MK03 Program templates, emails and landing pages (60/120/200) and SI03 Content migration with Content Transfer Tool (60/120/240). Moving people, choices and suppression flags is a mapped data load like MK02; rebuilding the active programs on existing templates is lighter than building the templates in MK03, so the base sits between the two. The low end is a few programs and one export; the high end allows for many active programs, several languages and several suppression sources.
ext: exports of people, subscription choices and suppression records from the current email platform
notes: Written for Marketo Engage from its user guide, glossary and quick-win pages. Usual flags: Unsubscribed for opt-outs, Blocklisted for people who get no email at all, Email Invalid for addresses that hard bounced on the old platform (Marketo Engage sets it itself when a certain type of hard bounce occurs in Marketo), and Marketing Suspended for temporary holds only. Operational emails ignore Unsubscribed and Marketing Suspended but are not sent to Blocklisted or Email Invalid people. Durable Unsubscribe carries the unsubscribe flag to other records with the same address; the other flags are set on every record holding a suppressed address. Boundaries: it follows MK01's instance and domain setup; MK02 builds the CRM sync, and Adobe's default Salesforce mapping pairs Email Opt Out with Unsubscribed, so the rule is applied in the CRM too; MK03 builds the templates the rebuilt programs use and the other landing pages and forms, and this service builds only the subscription center's page, form and subscription fields, on an MK03 landing page template where both are sold; MK04 cleans and scores data; XQ03 inventories programs and plans their move from Marketo Engage to Marketo Optimizer; MQ06 imports prospects into Marketo Qualifier; the knowledge base's consent and privacy topic covers consent banners and privacy requests. Adobe's Import Program moves programs between Marketo Engage subscriptions or from the Program Library, so programs from another platform are rebuilt. Admin communication limits are not in this scope.

steps: Inventory your active email programs, subscription types and suppression records, and agree with your legal team which choice wins when sources or the CRM conflict, such as the most restrictive.
Create a custom field for each subscription type and the subscription center, then import your people and their choices, checking a sample file against the export first.
Set Unsubscribed, Marketing Suspended or Blocklisted with Change Data Value flow steps on every record holding a suppressed address, and mark old hard bounces as Email Invalid.
Rebuild your active programs with no marketing email set as operational, and before the first migrated send, check its blocked people and that its recipients include no suppressed address.
deliverables: People, choices and suppression flags in Marketo Engage
Subscription center and rebuilt active programs
Pre-send check record for the first migrated campaign
asks: Exports of your people, subscription choices and suppression records from your current platform
A decision from your legal team on the rule for conflicting preferences
The active email programs to rebuild, with an owner who approves each one
method.risk: A person who opted out receiving a migrated email: we first send to internal test records, some set as Unsubscribed or Blocklisted, and confirm those receive nothing.
method.outcome: Your active programs run in Marketo Engage, with every subscription choice carried across and every suppressed person blocked from marketing email.
